answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the vine of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, reduced by each unverified claim, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. The gale is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the velvet. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
